newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Power plant up for tender in northern Kazakhstan.
newsitem.headline: Power plant up for tender in northern Kazakhstan.

text.p: Kazakhstan's State Privatisation Committee announced on Wednesday a tender for the Rudnenskaya thermal power plant in the northern Kostanai region.
The Committee has estimated the value of the station's assets at $26.5 million.
Under the tender terms, the winner will have to invest at least $114 million to keep the station running.

"The plant with an installed electrical capacity of 123 megaWatt/hours and the heating power of 920 gigacalories is currently working only at 40 percent of its capacity because it lacks finance to buy the coal it consumes," chief engineer Boris Rogov told Reuters.
The investor will also have to cover the company's debts of some one billion tenge and salary arrears of around 28 million tenge.
The State Privatisation Committee gave March 6 as the official deadline for accepting bids. Bidders will have to make a refundable deposit of 38 million tenge to take part in the tender.
The tender will take place on March 7 as Dutch auction.
